query: Who became Prime Minister of Japan in October 2025?
answer: Sanae Takaichi became Prime Minister of Japan on October 21, 2025, the first woman to hold the job [1][2]. In the lower house she got 237 votes, four more than a majority, against 149 for the main opposition leader, Yoshihiko Noda [1]. She took over from Shigeru Ishiba [1]. Her win was secured the day before, when the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) agreed to a coalition with the Japan Innovation Party (Ishin no Kai) [2][3]. She had been elected LDP leader earlier that month [3].
